Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: a square 1:1, hand-painted watercolor narrative illustration for an adult visual book, warm, thoughtful and lightly humorous. Create a complete new image from this description. The story shows a paid carpenter choosing responsibility for his work after the payment is already complete.

COMPOSITION AND READING ORDER
Three connected comic scenes within one square: two equally sized upper panels separated by a narrow clean white vertical gutter, and one wide lower panel across the full width. Read the upper RIGHT first, upper LEFT second, and LOWER scene last. The upper scenes together occupy approximately the upper half; the final scene occupies approximately the lower half. Use thin white gaps, no heavy black panel frames. Each scene has softly irregular watercolor endings, and clean white paper remains around all outer edges. Set the view wide enough to include every complete character, both feet or kneeling feet, the chair, table legs and all essential tools. Nothing is cut by a panel edge. Objects may naturally overlap, but torso-to-leg connections must remain physically continuous.

CONSISTENT CAST
The same PURPLE adult carpenter appears in all three scenes. The same LIGHT GRAY adult customer appears in the upper-right and lower scenes. They have identical medium, balanced, neutral adult builds: gently near-parallel torso sides, moderately sized arms, natural legs, neither thin and stretched nor round/chubby, no childlike or chibi proportions. No breasts, narrowed waist, protruding hips or buttocks, body indentations or gendered silhouette. No hair, ears, noses or necks. Heads are genuinely PERFECT CIRCLES with equal width and height, without a jaw, chin, oval shape or flattened lower edge, joining shoulders directly. A soft crescent of darker local watercolor under the head distinguishes it from the torso. Purple wears the SAME simple straight CREAM work apron in every appearance: shoulder straps, unwaisted rectangular bib and skirt, a small work pocket containing a pencil/ruler or small tool, and a modest tie. Gray has a plain gray body. No other clothing or shoes; feet are the same body color.
Faces have modest dark oval eyes with optional tiny white glints INSIDE the dark eye, simple eyebrows and minimal mouths; no surrounding white sclera. The customer's happy upper-right eyes are small closed upward arcs; the lower customer's eyes are open dark ovals. Do not add eyelashes to either character. Purple's face changes from pleased attention to payment, to thoughtful concern, to a calm responsible smile. Each anatomically complete hand has THREE fingers and ONE thumb; use simple natural grips without extra digits, allowing normal object occlusion.

UPPER RIGHT: PAYMENT AND DELIVERY
A modest warm wooden carpentry workshop doorway. Gray stands on the LEFT and holds the repaired small wooden chair; purple stands on the RIGHT, smiling eagerly and receiving a small cream payment envelope. The envelope clearly reads exactly "دستمزد". Purple's attention is on the payment. Gray is pleased and unaware of any problem. The chair is recognizable honey-brown wood with a simple solid backrest, flat seat, four legs and a horizontal brace beneath the seat. On the near-side horizontal brace joint is one clearly EMPTY dark screw hole, with two small unobtrusive emphasis strokes below it. The chair has not collapsed and nobody is hurt. Keep the chair complete and its perspective coherent.
The workshop background contains a few hanging hand tools, upright wooden boards, a small overhead warm lamp, a pale stone/tile floor and one modest green potted plant. A small hanging wooden shop sign at upper right reads exactly "نجاری". Keep both standing figures and their two feet fully visible inside this panel.

UPPER LEFT: THE MISSED SCREW
Later, the SAME purple carpenter stands alone behind a wooden workbench, wearing the same cream apron. His entire neutral body and both feet are visible beneath the tabletop; the bench's legs frame rather than hide both feet. In his hand on the image-right he holds ONE small distinctive brass screw. His other hand rests thoughtfully near his chin, with worried brows: he has realized the screw was left out. A closed payment envelope already lies at the left of the bench and again reads exactly "دستمزد". A black-shaft screwdriver with a red handle lies horizontally on the bench at image-right. Spare boards, a small tool holder and hanging workshop tools stay in the restrained warm background.
A white thought bubble above him, connected by small thought circles, contains a close-up of the wooden chair's brace meeting a leg and its EMPTY screw hole. It also contains the exact short Persian thought "این پیچ جا مونده!", comfortably arranged on two lines. This inset is a thought image, not a second real chair in the workshop. The brass screw and the matching empty joint make the discovery understandable at a glance.

LOWER WIDE SCENE: RESPONSIBILITY AFTER PAYMENT
At the gray customer's warm, simple home doorway, gray stands full-bodied on the LEFT, surprised kindly, with hands raised near his chest. The SAME wooden chair stands fully visible near center. Purple is to its RIGHT, kneeling naturally with continuous torso, hips, bent legs and complete feet, still in the same cream apron. He calmly uses the red-handled screwdriver to place the brass screw into the EXACT near-side horizontal-brace joint that was empty in the first scene. His other hand steadies the chair. The customer had not complained or discovered the fault; the carpenter has returned voluntarily. No additional money is exchanged.
Gray's speech bubble at upper-left of this scene, with a clear tail to gray, says exactly "ولی پولت رو گرفته بودی!", arranged on two readable lines. Purple's white speech bubble at upper-right, with a clear tail to purple, says exactly "کارم باید درست باشه.", arranged on two lines. Their expressions convey genuine surprise and quiet responsibility, without grandstanding. The setting has a pale peach wall, warm wooden doorframe at left, a simple patterned rug beneath the figures and chair, and a small cabinet, modest framed landscape and leafy potted plant at right. All bodies, feet, chair legs and screwdriver fit inside the scene.

WATERCOLOR AND FINISH
Authentic moderate hand-painted watercolor on visibly textured warm white paper. Show broad irregular overlapping translucent washes INSIDE heads, torsos, arms, legs and hands as well as backgrounds; luminous lighter patches, gently varied pigment density, soft natural bleeding and subtle pooling near some edges. Soft painted highlights, never glossy 3D shading. The character contours are darker versions of each character's OWN body color: deep purple around purple and slate gray around gray, never black body outlines. Keep cheeks within their own local translucent body wash: no sharp pink round spots or sticker-like blush. Wood is built from warm transparent washes and modest grain; backgrounds are purposeful and subordinate to faces, screw and chair. Maintain bright, gentle book illustration warmth without excessive decoration, heavy mottling, flat vector fills, marker strokes or uniform colored-pencil grain.

TEXT AND LIMITS
All in-image writing is ONLY the five exact connected Persian strings quoted above: "نجاری", "دستمزد", "این پیچ جا مونده!", "ولی پولت رو گرفته بودی!", and "کارم باید درست باشه." The payment label may appear on the two envelopes as described. Use correct joined right-to-left Persian, dark legible lettering and clear bubble tails. Do not place the English book sentence in the image. No extra captions, moral slogans, English, numbers, logos or watermarks. No injuries, broken chair accident, new reward, money pile, trophy, extra people or new narrative event. Keep the causal sequence clear: payment received, omitted screw recognized, voluntary repair after payment.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: a square 1:1 watercolor illustration for an adult visual book. Create a complete new image of friendship across generations through making bread together. It is warm, bright, slightly playful and immediately readable, with two spacious horizontal scenes stacked vertically within a square.

COMPOSITION
The upper and lower scenes are approximately equal in height, separated by a clean narrow WHITE gap without heavy frames. Each is viewed from the front at a slight elevated angle that shows the tabletop and the standing friends' full bodies and both feet below it. Keep the complete wooden worktable, its legs, every foot and all important props INSIDE each scene. Leave clean white paper around the full image with softly irregular watercolor scene endings. The upper-left of each scene contains a pale cream watercolor paper-shaped heading panel. Upper heading is exactly "جوانی". Lower heading is exactly "سال‌ها بعد". No speech bubbles.

CHARACTER SYSTEM
Three distinct adult friends across the two scenes: GREEN is the continuing central character on the LEFT in both scenes. In the upper scene green is a YOUNG ADULT and the friend on the RIGHT is an OLDER BLUE ADULT. In the lower scene the SAME green person is now an OLDER ADULT, while the friend on the RIGHT is a YOUNG PINK ADULT. All are equally capable friends with comparable adult stature, not parent/child, nurse/patient or teacher/pupil.
All have simple medium, balanced neutral adult bodies, moderate arms and legs and near-parallel torso sides. Never chibi, childlike, very thin or bulky. No breasts, pinched waist, protruding hips or buttocks, waist indentations or gendered body shape. No hair, ears, noses or necks. Heads are true PERFECT CIRCLES, width equal to height, with no oval shape, jaw, chin or flattened bottom. Each head joins shoulders directly, distinguished by a soft crescent contact shadow in a darker shade of the local body color.
Every friend wears the SAME plain straight CREAM apron with simple shoulder straps and an unwaisted bib/skirt; no other clothing, no shoes. Apron hems are visible below the tabletop. The body's own color continues down the two legs into simple rounded feet, with physically continuous torso-to-leg alignment. Each complete hand has THREE fingers plus ONE thumb; use natural dough/cutter grips with normal overlap and no extra digits.
Eyes use the book's minimal friendly design: small dark oval eyes where open, optionally a tiny glint INSIDE the dark eye; absolutely no surrounding white sclera. Smiling closed eyes are small upward arcs. Only the young pink friend has a few SHORT fine upper-outer eyelashes, added to the SAME modest eye shape and size. No huge lashes or doll eyes. No lashes on green or blue. In the upper scene BOTH friends have cheerful closed arc eyes and open smiling mouths. Older blue wears simple round clear-lens, warm brown-rimmed glasses, plus TWO OR THREE fine short dark-local-blue crow's-feet strokes near the outer eye. In the lower scene older green wears similar round clear glasses, cheerful closed arc eyes and TWO OR THREE fine short dark-local-green wrinkles beside the outer eye. Do not turn glasses into opaque eye whites. Young pink has friendly open dark oval eyes with tiny internal glints, short lashes and an open delighted smile. All cheeks continue the face's OWN translucent green, blue or pink wash, with no distinct sharp pink circular blush patches.

UPPER SCENE: YOUNG GREEN WITH AN OLDER BLUE FRIEND
Green stands on the LEFT and older blue on the RIGHT at a warm honey-brown wooden kitchen worktable. The heading "جوانی" is at upper-left. Both are happily making bread together. Green holds a soft, awkward, comically crooked long loop of pale golden dough with both hands; blue holds a tidier twisted pretzel with both hands. They laugh kindly together at the funny dough shape. Neither is pointing, scolding or instructing. Include a few short simple dark laughter/emphasis marks near the friends and dough, without words.
On the flour-dusted tabletop: at LEFT is one cream ceramic bowl with a blue horizontal band containing bread dough; near center is a small oval dough portion. At RIGHT is one complete shallow dark-gray-rimmed rectangular baking tray with a small pretzel-shaped piece and an oval dough portion. A red-and-white gingham cloth drapes naturally over the RIGHT table edge. Keep the tray, cloth and table complete, with enough room below the table to clearly show green's and blue's two feet.

LOWER SCENE: THE SAME GREEN, NOW OLDER, WITH A YOUNG PINK FRIEND
The heading "سال‌ها بعد" is at upper-left. Green remains on the LEFT with exactly the same green identity, circular head and balanced body, now with round glasses and a few subtle eye wrinkles. The YOUNG ADULT pink friend is on the RIGHT in the identical straight cream apron. They are delightedly inventing playful bread shapes together. Green uses both hands to finish a small pale golden RABBIT-shaped dough loaf in front of him; its simple long ears, small body and one tiny dark dough-eye make the rabbit shape recognizable. Pink lifts a small silver STAR-shaped cutter near the chest with the hand at image-right; the other hand rests naturally beside the dough on the table. Pink's eyes and smile face the shared activity. Add a few restrained joy/emphasis marks near the friends and star cutter, without words.
The same blue-banded dough bowl remains at LEFT, and flour lightly dusts the tabletop. In front of pink at center-right lies a flat pale golden oval sheet of rolled dough with TWO clearly star-shaped holes. THREE small loose star-shaped dough pieces rest between the rabbit and the sheet. At far RIGHT lies a small warm wooden rolling pin, fully inside the table. The red-and-white gingham cloth again hangs from the table's right edge. Do not put the upper scene's metal baking tray in this lower scene. Show both friends' full lower legs and complete feet below the table, green at left and pink at right.

KITCHEN SETTING AND CONTINUITY
Use the SAME restrained cozy kitchen and wooden worktable in both scenes, matching the chosen visual narrative. Pale peach/pink walls and warm pale terracotta-tile floor. At background LEFT is a wooden-framed window with soft green foliage outdoors and a red/terracotta pot of leafy trailing greenery on its sill. At background RIGHT is a simple tall open wooden shelf: a trailing leafy plant in a red pot on top, a cream lidded jar with a simple BLUE FLOWER decoration on the upper shelf, and a cream utensil holder with two wooden spoons plus a small wooden cutting board on the lower shelf. Keep decorative plants modest and subordinate to the friends and bread. The repeating room makes green's continuity clear; it is not a different character merely sharing the same color. The blue friend is present only in the upper scene and the pink friend only in the lower scene; do not add extra people or portraits.

WATERCOLOR FINISH
Real moderate hand-painted watercolor on visible luminous textured paper. Broad irregular overlapping TRANSLUCENT washes must appear INSIDE every head, torso, limb and hand as well as the room and wood. Use soft natural pigment variation, delicate pooling at some edges, lighter paper showing through and gentle painted highlights. Character outlines are darker shades of their OWN body color: dark green for green, deep blue for blue, dark rose for pink; no black body outlines. Keep the soft local-color head-to-shoulder contact shadow. No marker look, colored-pencil grain, flat/vector fills, glossy 3D, plastic surfaces, excessive watercolor blooms or heavy mottling. Avoid all sharp round pink cheek spots: cheeks blend softly into the local face wash. The scene should feel bright, tender, playful and handmade, with clean white irregular outer margins and no paint stuck to the file edge.

TEXT AND LIMITS
The ONLY writing anywhere in the illustration is exactly the two headings "جوانی" and "سال‌ها بعد", in dark, clear, correctly joined right-to-left Persian on the two cream heading panels. All other instructions are visual, not text to place in the image. No English, dialogue, labels, age numbers, dates, logos or watermark. No new story beats, prizes or moral slogans. The visible contrast is friendship with an older person in youth and with a younger person later: shared experience first, cheerful new shapes later, with the same green character continuing through both stages.
